department_name: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs (state-level) — District Food & Supplies Officer
subject_line: Application under Section 6(1) of the RTI Act, 2005 seeking information regarding: "I want to know the status of my ration card application in Gorakhpur district"
information_requested: Please provide the current processing status of the ration card application submitted for Gorakhpur district. Kindly supply the details of the present stage of the application, the name and designation of the official currently handling it, and the reasons for any delay if the application has not been processed within the stipulated timeframe. Additionally, please provide a certified copy of the movement register or log entries concerning this application.
declaration_note: I am a citizen of India, and hereby state that the information sought does not fall within the restricted categories under Section 8 or 9 of the RTI Act, 2005, to the best of my knowledge. I have enclosed the prescribed application fee of Rs. 10 (or a request for BPL fee exemption with proof, if applicable).
